title: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
abstract: arXiv:2611.21303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $\tau \geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. translated_title: 藏文OCR的音节级与词级评估
translated_abstract: 藏文的光学字符识别（OCR）目前主要以字符错误率（CER）进行评估。藏文标记音节边界但不标记词边界，因此词错误率的计算需要借助分词器。本研究在印刷体、木刻版以及两种手写体风格上，对九种识别器配置进行了单独及组合评估，并报告了音节级和词级错误率，据我们所知，这是首次针对藏文OCR开展的此类评估。这些配置涵盖CTC模型、带与不带训练后量化的TrOCR编码器-解码器模型，以及一个视觉-语言模型，每个配置均在CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词词错误率（SWER）指标下进行评分。结果显示，CER对系统的排序与更高层级的错误率基本一致（Kendall τ ≥ 0.833），但其中有一对系统的排序相反。在联合训练效果方面，64次比较中有7次CER与SER出现了符号相反的显著变化。SER无需分词器，且对系统的排序……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本研究首次对藏文OCR进行了音节级与词级错误率评估，发现字符错误率（CER）与更高层级错误率的系统排序基本一致，而无需分词器的音节错误率（SER）可作为更细粒度的评估指标。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first syllable- and word-level error rate evaluation of Tibetan OCR, showing that CER largely agrees with higher-level system rankings (Kendall τ ≥ 0.833), while the segmenter-free syllable error rate (SER) offers a finer-grained evaluation metric.
